predictions.claim: All six BendTT rejections are unsupported constructs, none a real disagreement: each minimized repro is a form BendTT does not implement or cannot normalize, which bend2 accepts. They fall into at most two constructs: one shared by the two Go laws and one shared by the four member laws.
The six keep REFUTED, recorded single-kernel I1 with their construct as the bendtt reason; no other M3 record changes status.
G7 passes on M3 at HEAD after the re-make.
CI's M3 check set gains G7, G4 and G6, and each passes on the lead; G1 is left out, with its reason (its regeneration of M3's outputs exceeds a job's budget).
Round 3's forged tree is refused by CI's M3 check set: G7 fails and names all six.

regressions.claim: The contract docstring and the instrument keep the sha256 pinned in thresholds.
holon audit prereg --milestone M3 prints PREREG OK.
The instrument imports nothing from holon/ or tools/.
B1: each registered repro has bend2 accept and BendTT reject.
B2: the registry names no law and the classifier names no target.
B3: the classifier's verdict on each of the six is OUT/classification.json's.
B4: the forged tree fails G7, naming every forged law.
B5: CI runs holon gate --milestone M3 with G7.
